bio.label: Or write about your work
bio.why: The more you tell us, the more your site sounds like you. Try to cover:

include.0: What you teach, and who you teach
include.3: How many years you have been at it

bio.placeholder: I teach … to … I trained as … and have been teaching for … years. My classes feel … and what makes them different is …
bio.example: I teach vinyasa yoga and breathwork to beginners and busy desk workers, online and in person in Brooklyn. I trained in a 500-hour program and have taught for 10 years, ever since burnout in a corporate job led me to yoga. My classes are slow, warm and practical: small groups, no showing off, and always an easier way into every pose. Students say what sets me apart is that I teach them to practise on their own.
bio.nudge: That is a good start. A few more lines about your background and what makes you different give you a better site.
